cd /work; python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0041.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
dark=(im.sum(axis=2)<260)
dark[:300,:]=False
cols=np.where(dark.any(axis=0))[0]
# report contiguous column runs
runs=[];s=cols[0];prev=cols[0]
for c in cols[1:]:
    if c!=prev+1: runs.append((s,prev)); s=c
    prev=c
runs.append((s,prev))
print('dark col runs',runs)
for a,b in runs:
    for u in [a,(a+b)//2,b]:
        r=np.where(dark[:,u])[0]; print('  u',u,'vtop',r.min(),'vbot',r.max())
" 2>/dev/null
